title: {Syn} The Higgs Boson Completed a Standard Model Chapter
content:
In 2012, experiments at CERN Large Hadron Collider announced the discovery of a particle consistent with the Higgs boson.

The Higgs field mechanism explains how many elementary particles acquire mass within the Standard Model, which is why the discovery mattered so much.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
